metadata.description: Agent skills that make an agent's output checkable: numbers with receipts, fake data that can't be mistaken for real.

plugins.name: notary
plugins.description: Before an agent states results, metrics, counts or costs, it writes a receipt for each number (file + exact quote, logged command output, calculation, or the user's words) and a checker verifies it. Receipts expire when their inputs change. A Stop hook sends back any reply with an unbacked number. Unmeasured values are N/A, never 0.

plugins.name: decoy
plugins.description: When an agent generates fake, mock, seed or synthetic data: only reserved values (RFC 2606 emails, NANP 555-01xx and Ofcom drama phones, processor test cards, never-issued SSNs, RFC 5737 IPs), a seeded generator script, and a data card. decoy.py lints the result.
